services.say: Built on a global production network, we make your designs on time and to a consistent standard.

High productivity and full accountability from start to finish.

services.name: ODM
services.say: Market insight from running our own brand team, combined with OEM capability — from concept to production.
features: We propose products and designs based on trend analysis and material research.
Patterns and samples are made in close work with our in-house team.
Materials, colours and details proposed to fit your brand.

services.name: Process
services.say: From idea to finished piece. No tech pack or reference product needed to get started.
features: We discuss design, quality, price, colour and size together and propose the best production terms.
Made by our in-house team, never outsourced, so feedback goes in at any time. Designed with production efficiency in mind.
Made in Korea or abroad, whichever fits best, backed by ASQ standards and active after-service.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
AMESCOTES, Inc. (the 'Company') protects users' personal data under the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea.

1. What we collect and why

To receive and answer inquiries, we collect company name, name, phone, email, preferred production site, expected quantity, inquiry type and message. We use them for no other purpose.

2. Retention

Kept for 3 years after the inquiry is closed, then deleted without delay, unless the law requires longer.

3. Third parties

We do not share personal data with third parties without consent.

4. Processors

Email delivery of inquiries: FormSubmit · Website hosting: GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.)

5. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion or suspension at any time at contact@amescotes.co.kr.

6. Contact

AMESCOTES, Inc. · contact@amescotes.co.kr

Effective 19 October 2026
